maya: Heads-up — prepping EBR packet for Atlas Ops on Tue 4/8. Need alignment on onboarding status, renewal signals, enablement owners, and a short exec slide. Sharing a draft checklist below.
tom: I can own the onboarding metrics slide (slide 2). Will drop numbers in by EOD.
anika: I'll take enablement recap + attendance graph. Any outstanding enablement requests from them I should call out?
liam: Renewal posture: ARR looks fine but CSAT dipped after the last rollout; flagged a spike in support tickets for workflow X. I captured notes in the account doc. Recommend a targeted adoption workshop with SEs as short-term mitigation.
maya: Agree. @liam please propose 2 date windows. @sue can you review the exec summary? We need a tight 1-slide "ask" for execs.
sue: Can do. Put a one-pager bullets doc in #product for quick review. Exec slide should be: 3 wins, 1 risk, 1 ask — 10 minutes max.
ops-bot: Calendar: Event 'Atlas Ops EBR — Redwood' created for 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC. Invite sent to maya, tom, anika, liam, sue.
tom: Quick data request: can someone pull last 3 weeks of active seats + top 5 failing workflows? I'll snapshot into the deck.
maya: I have query access, will send numbers by 11am tomorrow.
anika: Enablement ask: can SEs provide 2 short customer quotes/case snippets we can use on slide 3? @liam can you coordinate?
liam: Reaching out to SEs now, expect quotes by Fri.
maya: Draft checklist (owners in parens):
```
- Slide 1: Exec summary (sue)
- Slide 2: Onboarding & activation metrics (tom)
- Slide 3: Enablement + customer quotes (anika)
- Slide 4: Renewal posture + risk & mitigation plan (liam)
- Appendix: Feedback log + action items (maya)
```
Please update owners inline if you take additional items.
-tom: :thumbsup: I'll populate the onboarding numbers and add a short notes slide for the churn signal.
anika: :raised_hands: will attach attendance & completion graphs and the two customer quotes once liam confirms.
sue: If anyone has a 1-line "ask" for execs (budget/resource/SE time) — add it now. Need final deck by Monday COB.
maya: Draft deck link: https://redwood.slack/links/atlas-ebrdraft (placeholder). Note: call out churn risk from workflow X and proposed mitigation timeline.
liam: Also planning a 10-min NPS pulse for 8-10 key users pre-EBR to capture fresh feedback.
tom: Do we want a customer exec to join, or keep it internal? Exec ask may be sensitive.
maya: Recommend product exec + account exec join for the 10-min exec portion. @sue can you confirm who should be invited? Also need headcount for meeting invite.
sue: I'll confirm by EOD and loop in the right exec.
ops-bot: Reminder set: 'Deck final review' 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC.
maya: Thanks team — will close this thread after all owners update the deck. Tagging participants. :v:
anika: Added graphs to the shared drive and linked them into the draft deck.
